identification: Charlie Bears 'Chamberlain', Isabelle Collection (designer Isabelle Lee) mohair/alpaca limited edition of 350, 2013, about 59-60cm. Very dark brown/aubergine shaggy body and ears, tipped gold-brown ring round the head and tipped tummy patch, dark muzzle, brown suede-type paw pads, peach/pink organza ribbon with brass bell and white swing tag. Matches the sold Chamberlain 36/350 listing photo exactly.
